advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that drives the real produce_code_review_verdict to a mid-run outage and a workflow-failure under source=attested and asserts the resulting source/verified_at_sha/signable (especially that a degraded run is not spuriously signable).
evidence: The new shim tests stub produce_code_review_verdict (test_code_review_provenance_heldout_2d1c.py:41 `monkeypatch.setattr(gate_dispatch, "produce_code_review_verdict", _produce)`; test_code_review_provenance.py:105) so gate_dispatch's annotate_result never executes.
The only real-gate test (test_code_review_provenance.py:_stub_gate_run) sets run_workflow to a 'succeeded' verdict, exercising only the line-485 success path, never the degraded returns.

test_repo_snapshot.py:80 `assert handle.signable is True` — an attested handle is signable even on a degraded/INDETERMINATE run, so annotate_result on the degraded paths can stamp signable=True; no test asserts the signability of a degraded attested code review.
The existing outage test (test_code_review_ws4.py:157) uses _OutageRunner.preflight raising, hitting the un-annotated preflight degrade at gate_dispatch.py:354, and asserts no provenance keys.
ABSENCE: search of tests/ for verified_at_sha/signable surfaces no case that produces a degraded code-review verdict through produce_code_review_verdict and asserts its provenance stamp.
advisory.finding: The two newly-added degraded-path `gate_source.annotate_result(..., handle)` calls in gate_dispatch (mid-run LLMUnavailableError and workflow-failure) have no test: no test drives the REAL produce_code_review_verdict to those paths and asserts the stamped source/verified_at_sha/signable. In particular, whether a DEGRADED (INDETERMINATE) attested run comes back signable=True — since an attested handle is signable regardless of verdict — is untested, and that is the exact silent-signable-of-an-unreviewed-result danger this ticket exists to close.
scenarios: A mid-review LLM outage (attested mode) that degrades to INDETERMINATE but stamps signable=True from the resolved handle.
A workflow that returns not-succeeded / a verdict dict without a 'verdict' key, taking the line-496 return with a handle-derived stamp.
